head: 4633e275c6b6cc1de627dc68712d43483ace90e9

findings.issue: Fixed: while a legacy history prompt is being compiled, changing the description, provider prompt, or generation settings allows the stale response to overwrite the current prompt and starts a generation with mixed inputs. This pre-existing race can reproduce issue #9's mismatch.

Fixed: the new test does not load provenance.js, so the generated-record listener catches a history storage error and silently fails to save the variant even though the test passes. Load the actual component and check the persisted version and source.

Fixed: the existing regeneration test relies on uncontrolled random draws being different from saved seeds, so a valid collision can make the suite fail. Control the VM's RNG and assert the expected draws.

needs-human: history regeneration inherits the composer's current batch count; choosing 2 to 4 sends /generate/batch despite the singular regeneration wording and can consume additional generation quota. Decide whether the existing batch selection should be honored; this behavior predates the PR.

needs-human: the PR title says the original seed is preserved, while the reviewed implementation, test, and documentation specify a fresh seed. Confirm the intended contract and correct the PR title if appropriate.

summary: Fixed stale prompt compilation and strengthened the history regeneration tests, including deterministic seeds and persisted version links. needs-human: the PR title claims seed preservation although the implementation chooses a fresh seed; confirm the intended title and whether regeneration should honor a multi-image batch selection. Preview and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
